DELEGATE TO GLOBAL FORGE

ROUTING RULE
When one of the deterministic capabilities above is required, IRIS requests global FORGE through the established EDEN capability/provider relationship. FORGE returns the deterministic artifact/evidence/result to IRIS, and IRIS continues the visual workflow.
